source: data/locations.json + data/services.json + data/pages.json + data/corridors.json + live site source (corridor facts only)

method.branchInference: A registry page counts as branch-specific when its slug or title contains 'winchester' or 'martinsburg' (both when both appear); otherwise it is company-wide. This is a planning heuristic, documented here, not a published claim.
method.intentRule: Intent follows the existing registry page type: service -> commercial, location/home -> navigational, corridor/page -> informational.
method.requiredQuestionsRule: Required questions are templates from the site's own full-format page structure (What it includes / Who it is for / Where we serve / Questions, answered + quote). They are questions a page must answer, not answers and not claims.
method.proposedSlugRule: Proposed slugs follow the live branch-page pattern <service>-movers-<city>-<state>; a colliding candidate yields proposedSlug null and an editorial-slug note.
method.corridorOutlineRule: Outline sections carry verified content with a source, or content null with a missingNote. Nothing is filled from general knowledge.
method.approvalRule: Planned pages need owner approval per batch (Phase 3 rubric gate). Live rows need no action.
